item.description:
### Prayers
- Adhan reminders play again. The notification sounds were missing from 1.2.19, and the full adhan now plays from the app itself, since macOS cuts notification sounds off after about five seconds. - Clearer adhan recordings for Makkah and Madinah. - Fixed notifications for the coming week sometimes being deleted right after they were scheduled. - The Today timeline now fills from midnight to Fajr and from Isha to midnight, so the line always shows where the day is.
